question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Meticulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Regardless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (अतिसावधानी से करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **She completed the assignment in a meticulous manner, ensuring every detail was perfect.
 
 
 
• **"Regardless" **means without paying attention to the current situation or consequences; not careful or heedless. (लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example: **He made the decision regardless of the potential risks involved.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Meticulous' **is **'Regardless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Regardless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Persevering **(दृढ़): Continuing in a course of action despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
 
 
• **Example:** She was persevering in her efforts to complete the project on time.
 
 
 
• **Exemplary **(उत्कृष्ट ): Serving as a desirable model; very good.
 
 
• **Example: **His work ethic was exemplary, setting a high standard for everyone.
 
 
 
• **Determined** (दृढ़निश्चयी): Having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it.
 
 
• **Example:** She was determined to win the competition, no matter what it took.
